readout_semantics.DIRECT_payload: Known evaluator length for scoring native payload signs in saved fixed key/slot response sequence. Queries are not teacher-forced answer prefixes, because this diagnostic encoder ignores output prefixes entirely.
readout_semantics.complete: Stop/payload decoded from same saved fixed-slot response tensor per head. STOP head replaces EOS logits while retaining native payload signs. This is autonomous termination on a fixed-slot sequence, not own-generated-prefix autoregressive querying.
readout_semantics.conditional_ratio_warning: Do not interpret ratios between DIRECT payload and STOP complete scores as P(EOS | payload) for an own-prefix generation process.

finalization: Documentation-only clarification of fixed-slot readout and before-fit checkpoint refinement after source review; no additional fits or scientific compute.
